# order-configuration-ui-mockup-step5-6.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup.
**Source context:** `# Description` section, illustrating Step5 (legal
address, contact data, billing options) and Step6 (final contract
summary) of the order capture flow.

Two linked panels:

1. **Step5** — three grouped sub-forms: "Your Legal Address" (same
   street/postcode/city as the delivery address, with "Declare a New
   Address" and "Validate Legal Address"); "Your Contact Data" (mandatory
   mobile phone number and email address `john.smith@emailprovider.com`,
   with "Validate Contact Data"); "Your Billing Options" (Monthly Bill
   selected, day of the month = 1, "Bill sent to your email address"
   selected, with "Validate Billing Options").
2. **Step6** — the final "Your Order - New Fiber Contract Silver"
   summary: all previously configured items (Fiber Access Standard, Fix
   Communication Service, TV Channels, Box 1, Standard Shipping) with
   their prices, the running total (38,40€/month, -6,00€/month welcome
   discount, 32,40€/month total, 33,00€ for the first month), the
   configured billing day and email address, and a "Validate your
   Contract" action.
